title: energy-platform — freshness and ledger health (Silver, no Prometheus needed)

panels.title: Freshness per target (ADR-037 amendment 1: the target's own current rows, every mapped metric)
panels.description: pending · partial · late · complete (01 §5). age = now − newest non-NULL delivery start the target itself delivered.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT target_id, status, observed_periods, expected_periods,
       partition_start, expected_by, newest_delivery_start,
       EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - newest_delivery_start)) AS age,
       last_capture_outcome, stale_fetch_streak, source_unavailable, pipeline_failed, computed_at
FROM target_freshness ORDER BY target_id

panels.title: Ledger runs by state per target (ADR-024 §3)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT target_id,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'processed') AS processed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'captured') AS captured,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'failed') AS failed,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'missing_capture') AS missing_capture,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE state = 'unrecoverable') AS unrecoverable
FROM runs GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Capture attempts per hour by outcome (capture + backfill + recapture)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', a.started_at) AS "time", coalesce(a.outcome, 'pending') AS metric, count(*)::float8 AS value
FROM run_attempts a
WHERE a.kind IN ('capture', 'backfill') AND $__timeFilter(a.started_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Quality events per hour by kind (reconciliation_mismatch, unknown_field, quarantine, invalidated, …)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS "time", kind AS metric, count(*)::float8 AS value
FROM quality_events
WHERE kind <> 'partition_status' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Silver versions · occurrences · invalidation decisions (ADR-023, ADR-038)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM observations) AS versions,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM observation_occurrences) AS occurrences,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM invalidations) AS invalidations

SELECT DISTINCT ON (r.target_id) r.target_id, a.kind, a.outcome, a.started_at, a.error
FROM run_attempts a JOIN runs r ON r.id = a.run_id
ORDER BY r.target_id, a.started_at DESC
